title: Shopping assistant
description: agent-service health and usage (ARCHITECTURE.md §8). Source: infra/monitoring/dashboard.json

panels.title: p95 first token
panels.description: Request to first text. Target < 4 s (alert).

panels.title: Tool error rate
panels.description: Store failures (5xx/429/unreachable) per tool call. Alert > 5%.

panels.title: Handoff rate
panels.description: Support tickets created per new conversation.

panels.title: Confirm acceptance
panels.description: Confirmed ÷ confirm cards shown (returns, tickets).

panels.title: Thumbs up
panels.description: Up ÷ all ratings.

panels.title: Tokens / conversation
panels.description: Input + output tokens, all model calls, per new conversation.

panels.title: First token
panels.description: Request to first text_delta. Dashed line: 4 s alert threshold.

panels.title: Turn duration
panels.description: Request to done. Turns are capped at TURN_TIMEOUT_S (45 s).

panels.title: Model call duration p95
panels.description: One model API call, including the SDK's retries.

panels.title: Tool duration p95
panels.description: One tool run, including commerce-api retries.

panels.title: Tool error rate
panels.description: Store failures per tool call. Dashed line: 5% alert threshold.

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: By status; error_type is the HTTP status or connection error.

panels.title: Turn errors
panels.description: model_unavailable → fallback card; timeout; internal. Kill-switch refusals separately.

panels.title: Active SSE streams
panels.description: Replies streaming right now, across replicas.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Tokens per second by type; cache_read is the cached share of input.

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: rejected = login needed, not found, invalid input (expected); error = store failure.

panels.title: Confirm-first actions
panels.description: requested → confirmed / cancelled / expired / failed.

panels.title: Feedback
panels.description: Thumbs up / down.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: Estimated model cost in the selected range. Models without a MODEL_PRICES entry are left out (their tokens still count).

panels.title: Cost / conversation
panels.description: Estimated model cost per new conversation, all calls (chat, summaries, memory extraction).

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the provider's prefix cache: cache_read / (input + cache_read). Higher is cheaper.

panels.title: Cost by purpose
panels.description: Estimated USD per hour by what the call was for: chat, summarise, memory_extract, eval_grade.

panels.title: Cost by model
panels.description: Estimated USD per hour by model.

panels.title: Tokens by purpose
panels.description: Tokens per second (input + cache_read + output) by purpose.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: cache_read / (input + cache_read) over time. A drop usually means the start of the prompt changed between requests.

panels.title: Model routing rollout (PLAN-19 M6): routed vs control
Cost / conversation
panels.description: Estimated model cost per new conversation, by rollout group. Gate: routed at least 15% below control.

panels.title: Thumbs-down / conversation
panels.description: Thumbs-down ratings per conversation, by group. Gate: routed no worse than 1.5× and +2 points vs control.

panels.title: Handoffs / conversation
panels.description: Support tickets created per conversation, by group.

panels.title: Turn errors / conversation
panels.description: Turns ending in an error per conversation, by group.

panels.title: Turns finishing on the fast model
panels.description: Routed group only: turns that started on the fast model and weren't handed to the main model, as a share of all routed turns.

panels.title: Moves to the main model
panels.description: Why turns that started on the fast model went to the main one. fast_error rising means the fast model is failing (alert AgentFastModelFailing).

panels.title: Turns starting on the main model
panels.description: Why the routed group's turns started on the main model (rules in app/routing.py).

panels.title: Spend in range
panels.description: Estimated model spend over the selected range. Pick "Today so far" (UTC) to compare with DAILY_SPEND_CAP_USD: guests pause at 80%, everyone at 100%.

panels.title: Limit hits in range
panels.description: Requests refused by a spend or rate limit (app/limits.py).

panels.title: Provider balance
panels.description: DeepSeek prepaid balance (app/balance.py, every 15 min). AgentProviderBalanceLow pages below $2 or two days of spend.

panels.title: Limit hits by limit
panels.description: shopper_daily / new_chats from many guests at once suggests a bot (AgentLimitHitsSpike). store_daily_80/100 mark the store's cap being crossed.
